note: AFU non-muscle-invasive bladder. The guideline states its risk groups as headings under 'Classification pronostique', so routing follows the authors' own stratification rather than anything inferred from the passages.

default.note: The whole document is about NMIBC, so a passage no rule claims is still NMIBC guidance -- diagnosis, resection technique, instillation practice -- and applies at any risk. Absent here means 'risk not narrowed', not 'unknown disease'.

rules.note: Named `safety_reviewer` because this is a section about harm -- what a treatment costs the patient -- which is what that agent reads for. Its role was absent from the vocabulary until the fitness review; it is earned here, per section, rather than taken from the curation's document-level tag which 84% of records carry. The setting is the one these passages already carry, so this rule adds roles and purposes and moves nothing.
MUST precede 'haut risque', which is a substring of it. Reversing these two lines silently routes every very-high-risk passage to high risk.

'Nouvelles therapies pour les hauts risques' -- plural, so 'haut risque' does not reach it. Kept as its own rule rather than loosened, because a needle matching both singular and plural would also start matching 'tres haut risque'.
'Recidive sous forme d'une tumeur de bas grade multi-recidivante' -- the guideline treats recurrent low-grade disease as low risk without repeating the risk label.
